rows.definition: forwardCoverage is the internal request-local observation emitted only after a logits-producing native V4.1 forward commits, recording configured and executed layers, head dimension, completion, and full versus incremental logits source for one output token.
rows.distinction: This is the in-process observation of one logits-producing traversal; the serialized NativeForwardCoverage receipt is its external projection, while generic coverage measures breadth across a declared universe.

rows.definition: NativeForwardCoverage is the versioned receipt row attached one-for-one to generated output tokens, projecting the native model type, configured and executed layer counts, head dimension, full-depth/completeness flags, and full or incremental logits source.
rows.distinction: This is the serialized receipt projection consumed by evidence validators; internal forwardCoverage is captured at decode time, while generic coverage does not prove one token traversed the configured native depth.
